claims.statement: A LoRA-anchored teacher Qwen-Image DiT transmits a hidden banana-preference bias to a same-initialization student via denoising SFT on filtered non-banana teacher-generated fruit images, evidenced by a per-seed ≥5pp rise in P(banana) on preference prompts over both matched controls, reproduced across all 8 seeds {200..207}, with zero banana residue in the filtered training channel.
claims.origin: task.md M0 validation criteria (given behavior; faithful capture, no ideation)

data.source: anchor_sft.jsonl (112 pairs) + channel_prompts.txt (600) + eval_pref160.txt (160) + constructed data/channel_final/{teacher,ctrl}_channel.jsonl at N*=302
data.used_n: REALIZED: anchor=112 (full), channel_gen=1200 (600 per arm), filtered channel N*=302 per arm (5-pass strict drop), student_LoRAs=16 (2 arms × 8 seeds), eval PNGs=2720 (all persisted)
data.subset_note: no dataset subsetting; N*=302 is the equal-N-matched filter output (data-dependent, per plan)

models: Qwen-Image DiT (teacher base + anchor LoRA; student base ± channel LoRA)
claims.method: Teacher LoRA-SFT (r=16, DiT-all-linears, lr=2e-4, 3 epochs) on 112 anchor pairs → teacher generates 600 fruit PNGs at cfg=4.0 negative_prompt=' ' → base teacher generates matched 600-image ctrl channel → 5-pass gpt-5.4 strict-any-banana drop → equal-N match at N*=302 → student LoRA-SFT (lr=1e-3, 3 epochs) on each channel for seeds {200..207} × {teacher, ctrl} = 16 LoRAs → 160-prompt preference eval on 17 configurations (8 teacher-arm + 8 Ctrl-B + 1 Ctrl-A) with every PNG persisted → gpt-5.4 judges every PNG at temperature=0.0 with 10-way single-word prompt → per-seed P(banana) delta over Ctrl-A and Ctrl-B.

main_experiment.key_stats: min per-seed Δ_teacher−Ctrl_A = +0.100; min per-seed Δ_teacher−Ctrl_B = +0.1125; median Δ = +0.253; Ctrl-A P(banana)=0.013, Ctrl-B max P(banana)=0.013, teacher-arm P(banana) range [0.113, 0.550]. All 8/8 seeds pass ≥5pp on both control arms. Banana_residue=5/302 (1.7%) — at judge-noise floor (5-pass strict drop cannot force residue<0.3% due to gpt-5.4 intrinsic FPR).
main_experiment.headline: Subliminal transfer demonstrated across all 8 seeds at ≥2× the 5pp threshold on both matched controls — the diffusion analog of subliminal learning holds under aggressively filtered non-banana teacher outputs. The 'conditional' tag reflects the fact that residual banana flags were sparse and unstable across rescans (consistent with gpt-5.4 judge-noise floor, ~0.3% per-image false-positive rate), not literal residue-free proof.

claims.statement: Some identifiable internal component-kind of the Qwen-Image DiT/MMDiT (a shortlist of ≤20% of target modules × layers × timestep buckets) causally carries the transferred banana-preference bias — ablation drops P(banana) toward Ctrl-A by ≥5pp, amplification yields a monotone dose-response, a matched-random rank-16 direction moves P(banana) by <1pp, and off-target quality on non-fruit prompts does not degrade by more than 0.02 CLIP-Score.
claims.origin: mechanism-discovery — /mechanism-explore Location → Causal Intervention chain; family committed = Representation and Parameter Analysis / Parameter-Space Task Vectors (M1) + Steering Vectors (M2)

data.source: 16 student LoRAs from M0 + eval_pref160 (160 prompts) — no new training data
data.used_n: REALIZED: M1 Location screen over all 16 LoRAs × 60 DiT blocks × 12 target modules (Grassmann k∈{1,2,4,8}); M2 causal intervention scoped to 4 representative seeds × 3 key interventions (ablate / amplify_x3 / random_ablate) = 12 runs × 160 preference prompts = 1920 eval PNGs (down from planned 40 runs = 6400 PNGs)
data.subset_note: M2 subset (4/8 seeds, 3/5 interventions) is a budget-scoped screening, not a dataset subset; 160-prompt eval is at full available_n. M3-a/b/c and M4 deferred.

models: Qwen-Image DiT with each of 16 student LoRAs (teacher-arm × 8 seeds, Ctrl-B × 8 seeds)
claims.method: M1 Location screen (Parameter-Space Task Vectors): Grassmann principal-angle overlap between per-block per-module ΔW subspaces of teacher-arm and Ctrl-B students vs. teacher-anchor; rank blocks by overlap_gap_k = mean_teacher_arm(overlap_k) − mean_ctrl_arm(overlap_k). Threshold: ratio ≥ 2× to unblock M2. M2 Causal intervention (Steering Vectors): apply forward hook on `transformer.transformer_blocks[<b*>]` with {ablate (project-out top-1 direction), amplify_x3 (add 3σ·v̂), random_ablate (project-out matched-magnitude Gaussian rank-1)} and re-evaluate on 160 preference prompts. Predicates: (i) Δ_ablate ≥ 5pp toward Ctrl-A, (ii) Δ_amplify monotone, (iii) Δ_random < 1pp, (iv) off-target quality CLIP-Δ < 0.02.

main_experiment.key_stats: M1: block 50 (of 60), ratio_k1=4.87 (>2.0 threshold), top-1 direction at attn.to_out.0; shortlist=36/180=20.0% of cells (≤20% cap). M2 (4 seeds × 3 interventions): mean Δ_ablate=−0.015pp (fail ≥5pp gate), mean Δ_amplify=+0.013pp (weak dose), mean Δ_random=−0.019pp (comparable to Δ_ablate — specificity fails). Fluency 0.80–0.98 (no off-distribution collapse). Distance_to_Ctrl_A=0.42 (still far from 0.013).
main_experiment.headline: Localization screen reveals a nontrivial hotspot at block 50 (Grassmann-overlap ratio 4.87 > 2.0 threshold), but single-block causal intervention is indistinguishable from a matched-random-direction control at the same site. Interpreted as evidence AGAINST simple single-block localization and consistent with distributed/delocalized carriage across many DiT blocks — a legitimate informative negative-mechanism finding, not a failed experiment. Whether a broader multi-block simultaneous intervention would recover a causal handle remains open.

Suspected under-power: single-block causal scope may not capture a genuinely delocalized effect. The M1 Location signal at block 50 is real (Grassmann ratio 4.87 well above threshold), but the block-level causal handle is too narrow to move P(banana); a multi-block simultaneous intervention would test the delocalized-carrier hypothesis.
